txt: In the shadowy depths of the gap between the gates... there is nothing. Not even a single pair of blue eyes, vigilantly observing your every move. Whoever it was, he is gone.
The eerie pair of blue eyes is still here, gazing out from the dark void between the gates.
The eyes blink rapidly. They seem to be focused on following your every move.
The eyes blink rapidly. "No, I'm not, ha ha ha."
The eyes flicker in the darkness beyond the gates.
The mysterious pair of eyes attentively follow your every move.
The spooky pair of blue eyes is peeking in from beyond the gates. The look is very intense, as if trying to burrow into your very soul.
There is no reply. Only silence lurks in the cavernous depths of the darkness beyond.
"A good thing, too! I am not one of your fatuous Königstein neurosis analyst fucks, cashing in on the anxieties of nice ordinary folk. So, what now, Mr. Sensational Sleuth, sir?"
"A rallying cry for coppers everywhere! *We haven't done anything, we are never of any use*, ha ha."
"A serious bout of denial? Or perhaps the result of the incessant stream of alcohol you've been pouring down your throat?"
"Ah, but of course! It's all a huge part of the secret homo-sexual underground."
"Alright, you want more? We saw you try to punch that kid. A grown man, a *police officer* trying to punch a snot-nosed punk kid! A kid, for fuck's sake!"
"An intriguing mystery! I wonder what *terrible secrets* lie behind this dark and ominous veil, ha ha."
"And the other eye's on that hulking, blaring leader of the scabs. What a suspicious fucking guy."
"And we saw you got the body down. Oh, such wonderful progress! Hold the applause, ladies and gents."
"And we saw your attempt to shoot the dead guy down from the tree. That was an... exceptionally impressive failure, if I say so myself."
"Aren't we the lucky ones then? But I'm getting *real* bored with this... maybe it's time to change the subject."
"As if you've got better ones, Officer Bloodshot." A muffled voice suddenly clambers through the thick, solid metal gates.
"Aw, shucks! And here I was, getting ever so hopeful. Does the ardent cop-man want to ask *more questions* then?"
"Believe me, we know. We've got our eyes on you. Can't keep it to yourself, can you? Always creepin' into the lives of others, trying to dominate their actions, even their conversations."
"Bi-curious or plain curious?"
"Boo! The eyes of Martinaise are upon you, piggy!"
"Boring?! That you are always being watched and judged? Nothing you do escapes our grasp, we are ever vigilant."
"Do what, look?"
"Figures. What else is new! Certainly not a surprise when it comes to you nit-wit coppo-goons."
"From your perspective... I'm a Mysterious Pair of Eyes, boo!!"
"Getting too hot for you? Ha ha! Yeah, skitter off, find some actual criminals."
"Go think-man, go. Find some clues, put two and two together. That's how the magic happens, ha ha."
"Good plan, I was kinda getting bored of this topic already. What's next on the menu, Inspector Repression?"
"Good use of sarcasm there, man." You hear a faint clapping sound, brimming with caricature.
"Ha ha ha ha!" A loud, derisive laugh echoes wildly through the gates.
"Ha ha, you won't take us seriously? You will yet -- and you will rue that day."
"Ha ha. It was funny enough to me."
"Ha ha. Okay, good luck! I'm getting bored now... change the subject, why don't we?"
"Ha ha. Okay, you've got me *cornered* there, good sir officer. Anyway, this is really boring... change the subject, why don't we?"
"Ha... live and learn, lawman. Get out there and blossom into a flower! Go figure things out! Meanwhile, I'm getting bored... how about we change the subject?"
"Honest, my ass. Just look at the guy, geez!"
"Hum. Well, this went... nowhere. Zero fun and excitement here. I'm getting real bored, how about we change the subject?"
"I heard you." A muffled voice suddenly clambers through the thick, solid metal gates.
"I sincerely doubt it. You're supposed to help people and handle actual crime. Not walk around like an oppressive tyrant, passing punishments however you feel."
"I'm sure your story is very *unique* and not a stereotype-ridden re-hash of tired ideas."
"Indeed... oh yes. We know who you are, we do! Don't you worry about that."
"Is it now, is it *really*?"
"Isn't that what the judicial system is all about? The rules of law are developed and set for a reason. Well, this turned boring quickly... it's time to change the subject."
"It's a beginning, copper! You consider yourself a clean-cut, up-standing citizen? Don't worry, we'll get you yet... no keeping your nose out of the gutter forever."
"It's easy and comfortable to side with the ignorant, the arrogant, the condescending, isn't it? Hide away in the soft, secure existence of perceived superiority, a vapid fantasy of your mind."

"It's gotta be something *big* and *deep* and *important*. Because certainly you aren't some regular asshole avoiding the fact that he goes around fucking up everyone's lives with their self-serving, egotistical arrogance?"
"Just look at the guy, come on."
"Look at you, Super-Constable on his way to solve a suspicious case! Seems like that's going to take a long fucking while, ha ha."
"Look at you, little authoritarian. Bet it also makes you feel good and strong to discriminate against any disenfranchised people that get in your way. Makes you feel all *manly*."
"Looking. Peeking. Gazing. Staring. Watching. Ogling. Gawking."
"Maybe you're like a... masochist. Into humiliation and stuff."
"Mm, the delights of existence. A constant anguish and concern over horrible things you don't even know about, but can *imagine* so vividly. Ha ha."
"Most likely, Mr. *Amazing Investigator*. Aren't you a sharp-ass pencil! Maybe someone should write a novel about you."
"Nice going, Detective Thesaurus! You do know a few words, ha ha ha! Yeah, *spying* as well."
"No, no. That's... like... a super fucked-up thing to do. Seriously, I can't believe you still have your job. Everything else pales compared to this shit..."
"No. And even if I were, I'm not engaged in anything factually illegal. No crime here."
"No." A groan comes from the other side. "You're a complete tool, aren't you."
"None of your business. Ooh, so spoo-ooky!"
"Not a learned type? Sure is a shocker!" The eyes gleam brightly in the darkness of the void.
"Not through here, that's for sure."

"Nothing, sir, oh nothing at all! Please don't arrest me, I'm just a poor, honest man, trying not to make a mistake. Ha ha!" The sarcastic laughter effortlessly makes it's way through the thick gates. There's no stopping it.
"O-ho! I wonder what *harrowing mystery* lies behind this feat of self-destruction."
"Of course it's not, you numbnuts!" A groan comes from the other side. "Unbelievable."
"Of course! Amazing! If a little girl says so, it absolutely should happen!"
"Oh no, certainly not! Who would ever dare such a thing."
"Oh, sure, think up any justification you can for your fucked up, vicious deeds. Seriously, what a psychopath. You can't cover that up..."
"Probably a docker, aiming to block these loud-ass scab fucks from getting in. The guys get panicky sometimes..."
"Right now? You! Ha ha. We've got our eyes on you, believe you me!"
"Right. Good. You get it. We are watching you, ever vigilant. Nothing you do escapes our vision."
"Step right up, folks! Read all about the Incredible Adventures of Flop the Wonder-Cop! Able to solve the *most dastardly* of plots and ploys. Ha ha ha."
"Suit yourself!" The eyes gleam in the murky depths beyond the gates.
"Sure thing, pisspig, ha ha ha." The eyes blink rapidly. "Oh, and no, I'm not some fuckin' 'lookout' for the *leeches*."
"Sure thing, you pretty flower, you. Go and discover your *exciting* backstory. I'm sure it'll be one-of-a-kind."
"That so? Well I'll be damned..." He snorts. "Guess you ain't all shit-for-brains after all."
"That's a bit boring, don't you think?"
"The eyes. The eyes! There are eyes everywhere, copper. Beware."
"The gate is broken as shit. Someone absolutely destroyed the access panel in the control tower above."
"There are *so many* eyes all over the place, you can't even fathom it. Every hole, every gap, every nook -- someone will be peeking. You can't escape."
"Think you're some kind of a nice, clean, up-standing citizen? Don't worry, we'll get you yet... you can't keep your nose out of the gutter forever."
"Try not to hurt yourself, old man, ha ha." The pair of eyes beams impishly at you.
"Umm, what? That's not... *literal* -- there are not people actually stuffed into various tiny holes. You get that, right?"
"We are the eyes, we cannot be closed... if one pair shuts, another takes its place, ha ha!" The eyes grow wide and ominous.
"We saw you kick the mailbox. That's kind of a jerk thing to do, you know."
"We saw you point a gun at the little foul-mouthed girl. What kind of an insane bastard move is that? Fuck, what's wrong with you?"
"We saw you puke in the back yard, trying to get to the hanged man. Shows what a soft-bellied sissy you are."
"We've had our eye on you for quite some time. We saw you stumble out of the hostel, all messed up and stinking of booze."
"We've had our eye on you for some time now. And I can tell you straight... goddamn, you're one *boring fuckin' cop*!"
"Welcome to fucking Martinaise, piggy! We've got our eye on you."
"Well, we know what you're up to. We observe your every move. Take care and watch your back." The eyes suddenly disappear from sight, only emptiness remains, floating in the lacuna between the gates.
"What, did your brain shut off or something?" He grunts. "I don't understand how you get anything done. Well, whatever."
"Who do you think you are, being disdainful and judgemental about a person's private, idiosyncratic, voyeuristic-erotic preferences anyway? Fuckshit. Goddamn pigs."
"Wouldn't you like to know, fuckstick!"
"Yeah, I bet you are."
"Yeah? Does that happen to you often, Officer Heavyhands? Seriously, what a psychopath. You can't cover that up..."
"Yeah? I got a suggestion, you should go try knock the guard above us out. Ha ha, that would be fuckin' priceless."
"Yes. My identity. Ha ha ha."
"You know what you've done, don't start denying it now."
"You're apologizing to me after *I* called you a bunch of shitty things? Goddamn, now who's the weird one?"
"You're the one sticking your nose where it doesn't belong, coppola." The eyes blink at you.
"You've really fallen off the rocker, haven't you? This is getting boring, it's time to change the subject."
"Your life sounds like an immeasurable clusterfuck. Something's gone *really wrong*."
